subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: For this narrow Z.AI probe-header fix, should maintainers require redacted live Coding Plan endpoint-detection proof before merge, or explicitly accept the credential gap based on source/test evidence and the linked issue's live before-fix output?
rationale: The contributor says they do not have a Z.AI Coding Plan key, and only a maintainer with credentials can provide live proof or intentionally waive the real-behavior proof gate.

options.title: Run or attach live smoke proof
options.body: Provide redacted live output, logs, or a terminal screenshot showing endpoint detection selecting the Coding Plan endpoint with this patch before merge.

options.title: Accept an explicit proof override
options.body: A maintainer may approve the credential gap because the patch is a narrow provider-local header change backed by source and regression coverage.

options.title: Pause until credentials are available
options.body: Keep the PR open without merging until someone can safely run the real Z.AI Coding Plan smoke.

recommendation.title: Run or attach live smoke proof
recommendation.body: Provide redacted live output, logs, or a terminal screenshot showing endpoint detection selecting the Coding Plan endpoint with this patch before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest history signal for the GLM-5.2/Z.AI Coding Plan detection behavior and docs.
